subject.title: fix(talk): diagnose invalid OpenAI realtime auth

question: Should OpenClaw accept early key-shape rejection plus OPENCLAW_OPENAI_REALTIME_ALLOW_UNVALIDATED_KEY for direct api.openai.com Realtime auth?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it intentionally changes credential handling for existing OpenAI Realtime setups and adds an operator override, which is a maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept guarded diagnostic path
options.body: Merge this PR after normal review, accepting the narrow fail-early behavior plus documented override as the compatibility policy.

options.title: Require stronger live auth proof
options.body: Ask for direct OpenAI Realtime and Azure/custom endpoint live proof before accepting the auth-policy change.

options.title: Narrow to upstream error wrapping
options.body: Reject the early key-shape gate and keep only safer wrapping of provider invalid-key responses.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded diagnostic path
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after normal review, accepting the narrow fail-early behavior plus documented override as the compatibility policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main owner signal for the OpenAI realtime voice provider and moved the provider into the extensions boundary.
